Q1: Which branch should the fix be built on and merged into?
Choices:
A) PR #6646's head branch `ai/issue-6630`. The fix PR stacks on it and edits only line 656 of `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` and the `orchestrate_poll.yml` count in `tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:70`. Implementation needs a `Target branch: ai/issue-6630` routing line so it doesn't default to `main`. (RECOMMENDED)
B) The default branch, after PR #6646 merges. Hold this issue until then and apply the same two edits on `main`.
C) Make no separate fix. Close this issue as superseded and let PR #6646's own review/autofix fix it, since its editor already receives the failed `CI` check-run context.
Assumptions: The two edits named in the triage evidence are the complete fix. That matches the contract test's assertions at lines 127-140 and 139-140.
Missing context: I could not read PR #6646's branch, so I took line 656 and its expression from the triage log, not from the file.
